capabilities: Renders ```pseudo code blocks in CLRS typography
Builds pseudocode visually from typed keywords
Converts pasted code and selections into pseudocode blocks
Copies blocks as LaTeX algorithm code
Edits existing blocks in place, including in callouts and Canvas cards
extras: Embeds Computer Modern fonts so blocks look identical under any theme and in PDF export; warns and migrates settings if the Pseudocode plugin already renders ```pseudo blocks.
intentEvidence: If another plugin (such as Pseudocode) already does, Pseudocode Suite shows a notice
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write algorithms in CLRS textbook typography, so authors must hand-write LaTeX.

relations.evidence: Blocks written for that plugin keep working, and its settings are migrated automatically.

summary: Visual builder and renderer that turns typed or pasted pseudocode into numbered, CLRS-style typeset algorithm blocks with LaTeX export.
